name: brands-and-creators-monorepo
description: Brands & Creators — Production B2B Creative Marketplace SaaS

scripts.build: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/types/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/next/dist/bin/next build apps/web && node node_modules/next/dist/bin/next build apps/admin
scripts.typecheck: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/types/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p apps/admin/tsconfig.json --noEmit

author: Brands & Creators Engineering
